worldcombat.skill.confide.summary: Lean in and tell a foe a secret to break its concentration and lower its Sp. Atk. A whisper is sound: it passes through cover, but only carries as far as it can be heard. You may also turn it into gossip that distracts everyone standing near the target.
worldcombat.skill.confide.use.0: Blunt a special attacker from behind cover
worldcombat.skill.confide.use.2: Catch several enemies with one rumor while they cluster
worldcombat.skill.confide.description.0: The whispered target loses %1$s Sp. Atk stage(s) and stays distracted for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.confide.description.1: Whisper range %1$s; the rumor radius is %2$s and reaches up to %3$s more bodies over %4$s blocks, giving %5$s whispers at once.
worldcombat.skill.confide.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.confide.preference.rum: Off tells the secret to the one chosen foe only, with a short windup and cooldown and a longer distraction; on turns it into gossip that spreads to other enemies near the target, but each is shallower, the windup and cooldown are longer, and it is only worth it when someone stands beside the target.
The companion only considers speaking while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller keeps it at point-blank, larger starts sooner.
Countering speaks only while the enemy attacks the companion or its owner, or right after a hit; Anytime speaks at any threat.
In Rumor posture the companion only speaks when at least this many non-friendly bodies stand near the target, so the windup is not wasted; 1 means gossip whenever someone is there.
When on, the companion may leave its post to confide under a Hold order.
